findings.issue: Members of an element of a calldata array of dynamic structs are printed as nested offset arithmetic (requests[idx].srcPubkey's length is cd[_param1 + cd[_param1 + cd[32 * idx + _param1 + 36] + 36] + cd[32 * idx + _param1 + 36] + 36]), repeated in every validation and copy line of the loops, so the loops' bodies are hard to read although the loops themselves are found.
findings.rule: For a calldata array p of dynamic elements, cd[p + 36 + 32*i] is the element's offset o_i and the element starts at p + 36 + o_i; a member's offset is read at p + 36 + o_i + 32*k: print these as p[i] / p[i].field_k (and p[i].field_k.length, p[i].field_k[all] for bytes), as the text already does for top-level dynamic parameters.
